title: How Do Vaccines Trick Your Immune System? 💉
description: How do vaccines protect us from dangerous diseases? Here is the amazing story of how they train your immune system against viruses without causing illness.

scenes.text: How does your body fight viruses?
scenes.say: How do vaccines protect your body from dangerous viruses, without ever getting you sick?

scenes.caption: Your Immune Army
scenes.say: When a vaccine enters the body, it mimics the real virus but completely lacks the power to cause harm.
Your immune system spots the antigens inside the vaccine, and instantly starts producing specialized antibodies to fight them.
It is not just temporary defense. The body keeps immune memory cells that remember this virus for many years.
This early training gives your body strong immunity against the real disease, avoiding all risks and severe symptoms.
